name: gh-guru
description: Expert GitHub guide — gh CLI mastery (repo/pr/issue/run/release/api with --json/--jq), authoring GitHub Actions workflows, building custom actions (composite, TypeScript/JavaScript, Docker), CI/CD best practices, Actions security hardening (SHA pinning, least-privilege permissions, OIDC), and repository management (rulesets, CODEOWNERS, releases, GHCR).

interface.shortDescription: gh CLI, GitHub Actions, and repo management guidance
interface.longDescription: Use GitHub Guru to work with the gh CLI, author and debug GitHub Actions workflows, build custom actions (composite, TypeScript, Docker), harden CI/CD security (SHA pinning, least-privilege permissions, OIDC), and manage repositories with rulesets, CODEOWNERS, releases, and GHCR publishing.
defaultPrompt: Use GitHub Guru to write a CI workflow for this project.
Use GitHub Guru to review this workflow for security issues.
Use GitHub Guru to scaffold a custom GitHub Action.
